description: Explicit, versioned category membership for the ten Reuma medication fields. The three functional categories (Sistemicos / FAMEs / Biologicos) stay real UI and data semantics: each medication control may only offer options explicitly valid for its declared category. Membership is NEVER inferred at runtime from medicine name, dose, route, presentation, treatment context or history; it comes exclusively from this file.
membership_rule: A published-catalogue entry (data/catalogos/farmacia/hub_catalogo_farmacologico_dual_HOSPITALARIO_2hojas_20260606.xlsx) belongs to a category when its normalized commercial/presentation name starts with one of that category's declared catalogue_tokens (normalized exact-prefix key match). catalogue_tokens are declared identity keys joined deterministically at load time; they are not a heuristic. explicit_entries are identity-only medicine names contributed directly by this file for declared members that the published hospital catalogue does not contain (no therapeutic data is attached, ever).
provenance: The declared members are the historical explicit Reuma classification previously maintained in the 'Fármacos' sheet (columns Sistemicos / FAMEs / Biologicos) of Hub_Clinico_Maestro_V2_DEMO.xlsx, extracted verbatim and centralized here so the three forms stop maintaining manual per-form lists. Extending or correcting membership happens only by a new version of this file; the future CIMA/GitHub Actions catalogue automation stays decoupled from it.
coverage_note: Verified against the published catalogue 2026-09-28: Sistemicos has zero name matches (hospital-oriented catalogue lacks prednisolone/deflazacort presentations), FAMEs matches metotrexato/leflunomida presentations only, Biologicos matches 109 presentations across 44 of 51 declared brands. The uncovered declared members are preserved through explicit_entries so no category is silently emptied and no unrestricted fallback is needed.
